title: Ambrosia Energy will build a 10 GWh factory in Texas to make batteries for off-grid data centers | TechCrunch
summary: Even with “overbuilding” solar and batteries to deliver continuous uptime, Longmier said the company can be profitable at $100 per megawatt-hour, making it competitive with natural gas turbines that many hyperscalers are planning to use to power their data centers.
